summary.name: ixigo
summary.one_liner: ixigo is an Indian online travel platform for booking flights, trains, buses, hotels and metro tickets, with PNR status, train running status and flight status tracking.
use_cases: Checking PNR status and train running status
Tracking flight status, gates and delays
Buying metro tickets in Delhi, Mumbai or Bengaluru
Finding cheap bus or hotel deals in India
summary.what_it_does: The site is an Indian online travel agency (OTA) operated by Le Travenues Technology Ltd, offering booking for flights, trains, buses, hotels and cabs. It provides tools such as PNR status and confirmation predictions, train seat availability alerts, train running status and delay predictions, and flight status tracking with delay alerts. Metro ticket booking is offered for Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru as QR tickets paid via UPI. The page also lists fare drop alerts for cheap domestic flights and food delivery to train seats.
notable: Train PNR status and confirmation predictions, plus seat availability alerts
Flight status tracking with gate, baggage belt and delay alerts
Metro ticket booking for Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru with instant QR delivery
Claims ₹0 payment gateway fees on UPI train bookings
caveats: Free cancellation and ₹0 cancellation fee are advertised for flights; cancellation protection is stated for domestic flights only
Page does not specify fees for other services; pricing details are not fully stated on the page
Platform is focused on India; international coverage is limited to listed routes and destinations
